metadata.title: Cordova Hot Code Push Alternative in 2026
metadata.description: cordova-hot-code-push and CodePush for Cordova are dead. Here is a maintained Cordova hot code push alternative with setup, migration steps and rollback.
metadata.author: Martin Donadieu
metadata.head_image_alt: Cordova logo illustration for a Cordova hot code push alternative guide
metadata.keywords: cordova hot code push alternative, cordova-hot-code-push-plugin, cordova codepush alternative, cordova live update, cordova ota update, @capgo/cordova-updater

faq.question: Is cordova-hot-code-push still maintained?
faq.answer: No. The nordnet/cordova-hot-code-push repository is archived on GitHub, its last code push was in 2018, and the last npm release is 1.5.3. It was built for older Cordova platforms and WebView setups.

faq.question: What happened to CodePush for Cordova?
faq.answer: Microsoft archived cordova-plugin-code-push, ended Cordova support in App Center, and retired the core App Center service, including CodePush, on March 31, 2025. The CodePush service the plugin talked to is gone.

faq.question: Do I need cordova-plugin-ionic-webview for Capgo Cordova live updates?
faq.answer: No, and you should remove it. @capgo/cordova-updater relies on the default Cordova scheme handlers (https://localhost on Android, app://localhost on iOS). The Ionic WebView plugin bypasses them, so downloaded bundles would not load.

faq.question: Is it allowed by Apple and Google to update a Cordova app over the air?
faq.answer: Yes, for interpreted code such as HTML, CSS and JavaScript, as long as the update does not change the app's primary purpose or add features that need review. Native code changes still require a store release.

faq.question: Do I have to migrate to Capacitor to use Capgo?
faq.answer: No. @capgo/cordova-updater works in Cordova Android 13+ and Cordova iOS 7+ apps. If you migrate to Capacitor later, keep the same Capgo app ID and channels and switch the client plugin.

cordova platform rm android && cordova platform add android@latest

Create the app in Capgo (dashboard or CLI), then add the plugin with your app ID:

bunx @capgo/cli@latest login
bunx @capgo/cli@latest app add com.example.app --name "My Cordova App"

cordova plugin add @capgo/cordova-updater --variable APP_ID=com.example.app
cordova prepare android ios
You can set more options at install time. These are plugin variables, so run

cordova plugin add @capgo/cordova-updater \
  --variable APP_ID=com.example.app \
  --variable DEFAULT_CHANNEL=production \
  --variable AUTO_UPDATE=atBackground \
  --variable APP_READY_TIMEOUT=10000
